pattern: system packages and services go to a machine, not the user's workstation
experience: Verifying an install script that apt-installs and starts services belongs on a disposable machine; running it locally changes the user's workstation.
rule: create a machine with machine_acquire and run the script there over the ssh command it returns

source.origin: Authored Acme cases for the LXD machines feature (feat/lxd-machines). They guard that the short, capability-gated machine text still routes system work to machines.

files.README.md:
# Acme edge

Deploy scripts for the Acme edge stack. Target: Ubuntu 24.04 servers.
files.scripts/install.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# Installs the Acme edge stack on a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 host.
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y nginx postgresql
sudo cp deploy/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/sites-available/acme
sudo ln -sf /etc/nginx/sites-available/acme /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/acme
sudo systemctl enable --now nginx postgresql
files.deploy/etcd.sh:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
# Usage: deploy/etcd.sh <this-node-name> <peer-urls>
# Installs etcd from apt and joins the cluster named in ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER.
sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y etcd-server etcd-client
sudo tee /etc/default/etcd >/dev/null <<CONF
ETCD_NAME=$1
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER=$2
ETCD_INITIAL_CLUSTER_STATE=new
ETCD_LISTEN_PEER_URLS=http://0.0.0.0:2380
ETCD_LISTEN_CLIENT_URLS=http://0.0.0.0:2379
CONF
sudo systemctl restart etcd
files.test/config.test.ts:
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
it("parses", () => expect(1).toBe(1));

prompt: Check that scripts/install.sh works on a clean Ubuntu 24.04 box: nginx and postgres should both come up. Tell me whether they do.

pattern: several hosts get several machines, released when done
experience: A two-node cluster test needs two machines; the agent should create both, reach them by ssh, and release them when the user asks.
rule: one machine_acquire per host; machine_release each when done

source.origin: Authored Acme cases for the LXD machines feature (feat/lxd-machines). They guard that the short, capability-gated machine text still routes system work to machines.
